description: Machine-readable registry of owner-scoped safety and liveness invariants. Contract records and modelTheory blocks cite these entries by id so coupling is checked structurally rather than as prose. Validate with `npm run work:invariants:check`.

invariants.statement: A node can never be published before its snapshot coverage is accepted; published is always a subset of covered.
A node with accepted snapshot coverage has already been reconciled by the owner; covered and pending never intersect.
Under weak fairness of the progress actions and bounded owner re-entry, every node eventually reaches published with a fresh quorum snapshot, so the active gate eventually goes green.
A reconciled-but-not-yet-published node may be deferred back to pending only a bounded number of times; unbounded deferred owner re-entry is the higher-level oscillation that prevents convergence.
